title: checkin
description: One row per check-in, so two devices checking in offline make two rows and neither is lost. Taking a round back sets deleted, and may first write round on others so they stay where they are.

day.description: The local day it counts for.

round.description: Which of the day's times it was (1 for the first, 08:00), when the person ticked one. Absent: it fills the lowest round still empty. Optional, so an older build's check-in still counts.
